name: Mac Alerts
author: Slashbar
description: Turn text into macOS notifications and speech

commands.name: Show as Notification
commands.body: t=$(head -c 200); osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification (item 1 of argv) with title "Slashbar"' -e 'end run' "$t"
commands.description: Pop the text as a macOS notification.

commands.name: Speak Text
commands.description: Read the text aloud with the system voice.
